My research sits at the intersection of sociology, political science, and computational
methods.

## Current Projects

**PhD project** · London School of Economics, 2025–present
: My doctoral research examines how British political elites have constructed and
  represented marginalization over the past century. Methodologically, I develop
  validation approaches for computationally generated text measurements.

**ESRC Project *The Politics of Memory*** · University College London, 2024–present
: Predoctoral Researcher in Computational Social Science (2024–2025), and research and
  teaching assistant since 2025, in the Department of Political Science.
